title: Product Exclusivity Gap
scenario: Find 'customer_id' who bought some products but never purchased any products where the 'product_key' is greater than 100.
hint: Use NOT IN or EXCEPT to filter out customers who bought products with key > 100.
correctQuery: SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer WHERE product_key > 100;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE customer (customer_id INT, product_key INT); INSERT INTO customer VALUES (1, 50), (2, 150);
